messages.content: What was our Q3 2025 revenue and how did it break down?

Q3 2025 total revenue was $42.8M, up 23% year-over-year. Enterprise contracts contributed $28.1M and self-serve accounted for $14.7M. The EMEA region drove the majority of growth with a 41% increase in new logo bookings.

GPU compute spend was $8.4M across 10 providers. B200 clusters accounted for 62% of spend but 78% of throughput. We recommend increasing reserved B200 allocation by 15% and migrating EU inference from us-east-1 to eu-west-1 to reduce latency by 40ms.
What are the three evaluation gates for production deployment?

1. Holdout perplexity within 10% of base model on general text. 2. Domain-specific accuracy >= 85% on curated eval set. 3. Safety evaluation showing no degradation from base model. Models failing any gate are rolled back.
How does the customer onboarding playbook work?

It is a four-phase process over 8 weeks: Phase 1 deploys the base model and runs baseline evals. Phase 2 collects domain examples and runs SFT with LoRA. Phase 3 iterates on failure modes. Phase 4 optionally runs full-parameter CPT followed by SFT, then deploys to production.
What is our API rate limiting policy?

Free tier: 10 req/min, 1,000/day. Pro: 60 req/min, 10,000/day. Enterprise: custom with 2x burst. Limits are per API key. Token-based limits may be introduced in Q4 2025. Rate limit headers are included in all responses.
